about_section: Este Medical Group is an international hair, skin and aesthetic services provider operating a UK network of clinics. The Edinburgh branch at 37 York Place (EH1 3HP) offers hair restoration (DHI/FUE), advanced skin and non-surgical aesthetic treatments (injectables, lasers, skin resurfacing, body treatments) and free consultations with tailored treatment plans. about_section: Dermoperfection is a CQC-registered, medical-led skin and aesthetics clinic located in The Mailbox, Birmingham. The clinic offers a broad range of advanced non-surgical and medical-aesthetic treatments (injectables, dermal fillers, advanced device therapies such as INTRAcel Pro, ULTRAcel Q+, EMFACE/EMSCULPT NEO, chemical peels, medical facials and medical-grade skincare). Founded and led by Stuart (Stu) Logan, the clinic positions itself as a results-driven, evidence-led practice and a flagship PCA Skin and Obagi Medical partner in Birmingham.

about_section: InSkin Group is a multidisciplinary, doctor- and clinically-led skin, aesthetic and tattoo clinic based at 29 Oxford Road, Altrincham (WA14 2ED). The clinic combines medical dermatology and aesthetic services (doctor-led injectables, mole/skin lesion treatment and skin cancer screening), advanced skin therapies (microneedling, peels, radiofrequency, laser hair removal), electrolysis, semi-permanent makeup, and bespoke tattoo services. The clinic promotes evidence-based care delivered by a mix of doctors, nurses, clinical therapists and experienced tattoo artists in a dedicated treatment centre in Altrincham.

about_section: Weston Beauty Clinic is a medically-led aesthetics and advanced beauty clinic located at The Round Pond, Bristol Road (A370), Hewish, Weston-super-Mare, BS24 6RD. about_section: Cosmedicare is a Scotland-based private cosmetic surgery and aesthetic services provider operating consultant-led surgical and non-surgical services from purpose-built private hospitals in Livingston and Glasgow. about_section: C&S Aesthetics is a doctor-led medical aesthetics and private dermatology service operating in Swindon. The clinic is led by Consultant Dermatologist Dr Charan (Charankumal) Singh Thandi and supported by clinical pharmacist Simran Kaur Thandi. Services include consultant dermatology consultations (skin cancer/mole/lesion assessment and minor skin surgery), medical aesthetics (anti-wrinkle injections, dermal fillers, non-surgical rhinoplasty, skinboosters), SkinPen microneedling, chemical peels, IV infusions and benign lesion removal. The team run regular clinics from 96 Cricklade Road (Kays Beauty Salon / Gorse Hill) and provide some private dermatology consultations via partner sites (e.g., Cotswold Surgical Partners / Unit 13 Interface Business Park).

about_section: Dr James S. Halpern is a consultant dermatologist who holds substantive NHS consultant and clinical leadership roles (Clinical Director / Lead Consultant in Dermatology) at Walsall Manor Hospital (Walsall Healthcare NHS Trust) and The Royal Wolverhampton Hospitals (New Cross). about_section: Coppergate Clinic is a boutique private hospital and aesthetic clinic in the heart of York offering plastic surgery (face, breast, body), a wide range of advanced aesthetic and non-surgical skin treatments, and a specialist skin lesion service. It operates under the local NHS Wales arrangements (Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board) and patients register with the practice for NHS primary care.
